title: 第396章 先管这些人第395章 济世药行
slug: 丹尊至上第391章驿站交接
content_zh:
二十七个名字，就这么被抄在了二十七张白纸上。
赵灵儿没让人把这些名字合成一份名单。
每一张白纸上面，都只写了一个人的姓名、年岁、籍贯、家里的亲属，还有最后一次出现的时间。
这么分开写，一是为了让不同的暗卫可以同时去调查，二也是为了避免万一哪份名册被抢走了，导致所有人的家属信息都暴露出去。
在城主府的密室里，摆了三张长桌子。
第一张桌子上放了七张纸，这七个人，就是从驿站车里救下来的那些人。
枯荣已经检查过了，这七个人只是被迷魂汤和连魂线给控制住了，还没有真的被钉入摄魂钉。
只要好好休养几天，她们的神魂就能恢复过来。
第二张桌子上放着九张纸。
在济世药行的底册上，这九个人的名字后面都盖了一个“已验”的红印子。
赵灵儿手下的人查到，这里面有五个人已经被送出了大乾的边境，另外四个人的路引记录，则是停在了东荒的北线。
第三张桌子上，放的是十一张纸。
这些人虽然还没被抓，但是已经被济世药行把住处、家人还有日常的行踪都查得一清二楚了。
林墨正带着林家外务堂的人一个一个的核对。
“这十一个人里面，有三个在青云城，四个在附近的县城，剩下的四个人比较分散，都在边城。”
赵灵儿说：“先保护起来，不要直接把人带进皇宫。”
朱有福不解的问：“这是为什么？”
“要是突然把人全都接走了，那药行马上就会知道名单已经泄露了。”
她说着，就在其中一张纸上画了一道细线。
“去给她们安排一下，就说有的回娘家了，有的被宗门看中了，还有的因为生病暂时闭门不出。”

“每个人身边都安排两名暗卫跟着，尽量别搞出大动作来。”
朱有福点了点头。
要是只让林天自己来做事，那最简单的法子就是把这十一个人全部送到一个安全的地方去。
但一个王朝毕竟不是神魂空间，总不能一遇到危险就把老百姓全都收起来。
所以，在保护她们的时候，还必须得让药行那边误以为，他们的筛选工作还在继续。
李清雪这时候正坐在第一张桌子的旁边。
那个青衣女子已经醒了过来，正靠在软榻上，手里还捧着一碗温热的药汤。
这个女子名叫周芸，今年二十三岁，是从青云城北边的石河县来的，也是这七个人里头唯一一个有修为在身的。
“你们是在哪里被抓的？”
李清雪开口问道。
“石河县外面的一个临时药棚。”
周芸的声音听起来还有点虚弱。
“济世药行的人说，可以免费替女子验体，要是有灵根的话，还能推荐去中州的宗门。我本来没想去的，是陪我表妹去看病。后来药师就说她体寒，要留下来观察一夜。”
“所以你就留下了？”
“嗯，我不放心她一个人。”
周芸说着，就低头看了一眼旁边另一张床上的人。
她的表妹才十七岁，也是这七个人里的一个。
她们俩当天晚上就被迷倒了，等醒过来的时候，人已经在车里了。
那些押送的人可能以为她修为不高，所以没有把她完全封死，这才让她断断续续的听到了“北庄”、“验血”还有“三日”这么几个词。
“路上换过车没有？”

“换过一次。”
content_en:
Twenty-seven names were copied on twenty-seven pieces of white paper.
Zhao Ling'er didn't ask anyone to compile these names into a list.
On each piece of white paper, only a person's name, age, place of origin, family relatives, and the time of last appearance were written.
The purpose of writing them separately is to allow different secret guards to investigate at the same time, and also to prevent everyone's family information from being exposed if any of the rosters are taken away.
In the secret room of the city lord's mansion, there were three long tables.
There were seven pieces of paper placed on the first table. These seven people were the people rescued from the stage car.
Ku Rong has already checked and found that these seven people were only controlled by the soul-enchanting soup and the soul-linking thread, and had not really been nailed into the soul-capturing nails.
As long as they rest for a few days, their spirits can recover.
There are nine pieces of paper on the second table.
In the booklet of Jishi Medicine Store, the names of these nine people all have a red stamp of "verified" stamped on them.
Zhao Ling'er's people found out that five of them had been sent out of the border of Daqian, and the route records of the other four people stopped at the northern line of Donghuang.
On the third table, there are eleven pieces of paper.
Although these people have not been arrested yet, their residences, family members, and daily whereabouts have all been traced by Jishi Medicine Store.
Lin Mozheng took the people from the Lin Family Foreign Affairs Office to check one by one.
"Among these eleven people, three are in Qingyun City, four are in nearby counties, and the remaining four are relatively scattered, all in border towns."
Zhao Ling'er said: "Protect them first, don't bring them directly into the palace."
Zhu Youfu asked puzzledly: "Why is this?"
"If everyone is picked up suddenly, the drug store will immediately know that the list has been leaked."
As she spoke, she drew a thin line on one of the papers.
"Go and make arrangements for them. Some of them have returned to their parents' homes, some have been favored by the sect, and some are temporarily staying behind closed doors because of illness."
"Arrange two secret guards around each person, and try not to make any big moves."
Zhu Youfu nodded.
If Lin Tian was left to do things by himself, the simplest way would be to send all eleven people to a safe place.
But after all, a dynasty is not a spiritual space, and it cannot just hide all the people when it encounters danger.
Therefore, when protecting them, they must also make the drug store mistakenly think that their screening work is still going on.
Li Qingxue was sitting next to the first table at this time.
The woman in green clothes had woken up and was leaning on the soft couch, holding a bowl of warm medicinal soup in her hand.
This woman's name is Zhou Yun. She is twenty-three years old. She comes from Shihe County, north of Qingyun City. She is also the only one among the seven who has some cultivation.
"Where were you arrested?"
Li Qingxue asked.
"A temporary medicine shed outside Shihe County."
Zhou Yun's voice still sounded a little weak.
"The people at Jishi Medicine said they could do a physical examination for the woman for free. If she has spiritual roots, she could also recommend a sect in Zhongzhou. I originally didn't want to go, but to accompany my cousin to see a doctor. Later, the pharmacist said she was cold and had to stay for observation overnight."
"So you stayed?"
"Well, I don't worry about her being alone."
As Zhou Yun spoke, she lowered her head and glanced at the person on the other bed next to her.
Her cousin was only seventeen years old and one of these seven people.
The two of them were fascinated that night, and when they woke up, they were already in the car.
Those escorting her might have thought that her cultivation level was not high, so they did not seal her completely. This was why she heard the words "Beizhuang", "blood test" and "three days" intermittently.
"Have you changed cars on the way?"
"Changed it once."
